-- Verificar se Gilson e Alexandre têm cadastro em allowed_clients
SELECT 
  u.id AS user_id,
  u.name AS user_name,
  u.email AS user_email,
  u.lastSignedIn,
  ac.id AS client_id,
  ac.name AS client_name,
  ac.email AS client_email,
  ac.is_active,
  COUNT(cq.id) AS total_quotas
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN allowed_clients ac ON LOWER(ac.email) = LOWER(u.email)
LEFT JOIN client_quotas cq ON cq.client_id = ac.id AND cq.is_active = 1
WHERE u.email IN ('gilsonribeiro39@icloud.com', 'wdfxrpb84y@privaterelay.appleid.com', 'erisvaldo1308@gmail.com')
GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email, u.lastSignedIn, ac.id, ac.name, ac.email, ac.is_active;
